interpretation: Aligned pose decoding must outperform the strongest prespecified within-session temporal-misalignment control selected on validation in a strict majority of at least six eligible animals and have positive median paired validation effect before test consumption is allowed. Animals whose aligned or selected-null validation median Pearson correlation is not computable are excluded before test and cannot later enter confirmatory inference. The primary final comparator is the null fraction selected on validation, never the strongest null chosen from test scores. The confirmatory population is exactly the validation-eligible animals frozen in validation-unlock.json. Final support requires every validation-eligible animal to have a computable held-out paired effect, at least six such animals, a positive median paired test effect, and an exact one-sided sign-test p <= 0.05 for positive aligned-minus-selected-null effects. Zero effects count as non-positive. No minimum absolute correlation threshold is introduced.
